acceptance.nativeComparison: Every non-membership result and design value serialized byte-exact versus the previous native owner; every observation identity, cell count and explicit source membership reference exact. Native reconstruction must pass.
acceptance.references: Run edgeR QL, limma-voom and DESeq2 on the same complete aggregate count/filter/design, with shared declared offsets and package normalization reported separately. Differences and failures retained; no requirement that unlike tests have identical p-values.
acceptance.memory: Record per-native-process peak RSS; implementation runner differs from product routing, so no end-to-end speedup claim.
